sources.description: The Baltimore Ravens had their three-game win streak snapped by the Cleveland Browns on Sunday. The Ravens were shut out after the first quarter in a low-scoring affair and lost 13-10. Here are report card grades for the team’s offense and defense in the Week 6 defeat.
